title: My Bookmarks
subtitle: Data Engineering Pipeline & Bookmark Governance with Local AI
summary: Chrome bookmark data pipeline with Canonical Domain Model, local AI classification (Ollama qwen2.5/deepseek-r1), RAG engine, and zero-conflict bidirectional reconciliation.
overview: Treats chaotic bookmark collections as a data engineering pipeline decoupled from browser formats. Implements a versioned Canonical Domain Model adhering to the core principle: 'AI suggests, deterministic systems validate, human authorizes, engine executes.' Built across 9 Milestones (M1-M9), incorporating HTML parsing, domain entropy statistics, local AI governance (Ollama qwen2.5/deepseek-r1), conversational RAG, and atomic bidirectional reconciliation with Chrome.
roleDescription: Principal Software Engineer & Solutions Architect — Pipeline architecture design, AI governance, and Jidoka quality suite.
responsibilities: End-to-end design of the data pipeline defining immutable boundaries between ingestion, canonical modeling, and physical execution.
Implementation of human-in-the-loop AI governance strategy and RAG engine integration using Ollama (qwen2.5 / deepseek-r1).
Engineered rigorous test suite with JIDOKA validation and SHA-256 cryptographic guarantees preventing data loss.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: False positive overflow during Bidirectional Reconciliation (M7), where identical URLs across different folders generated thousands of fake tree diff conflicts.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered the Stable Identity Matcher with a composite key (URL + folderPath + occurrence), reducing conflicts to exactly zero for a perfect 1:1 diff.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: AI semantic over-merging (M3.1) suggesting dangerous folder merges between unrelated clients sharing common names (e.g., 'Testing').
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built Hard Safety Gates (M3.2) introducing deterministic scope boundaries (GLOBAL, PROJECT, CLIENT) that reject structural aberrations before AI scoring.

futureEvolution: Development of a native browser extension companion for real-time bookmark capture and tagging.
Evolution into an interactive visual dashboard for live proposal reviews and tree diff visualization.

owaspMitigations.title: Local Privacy & Prompt Injection Containment
owaspMitigations.description: 100% local LLM inference via Ollama. Untrusted bookmark data isolated in <untrusted_bookmark_data> tags paired with M9 grounding validation to reject indirect prompt injections.

owaspMitigations.title: Data Integrity & Cryptographic Hash Lineage (SHA-256 Epoch Lock)
owaspMitigations.description: Every pipeline stage (M3 Plan, M4 Manifest, M5 Execution) is locked with a unique SHA-256 hash, immediately aborting execution or rollbacks if files are tampered with.
